summary: Share initial capabilities discovery between browser outbox recovery and send grants

replay.detail: No replay behavior changes; unresolved sends remain non-retryable.

schema.detail: No browser or server storage schema changes.

compatibility.detail: Live-source startup recovery and initial grants now use one capabilities response instead of issuing duplicate reads. Reconnect still fetches current capabilities; the recovery admission barrier is unchanged.

downtime.detail: No service interruption or restart is required.

recovery.detail: Existing persisted attempts retain their original scope and recovery state. Identity or storage failures still withhold send grants without affecting read access.
